children: TDS announced it is no longer pursuing the acquisition of Array public shares and will resume share repurchases.
TDS withdrew its proposal to acquire Array common shares it does not own and will retain its ~82% stake in Array.
Under the withdrawn proposal, each Array share would have been exchanged for 0.86 TDS common share.
TDS and Array intend to increase efforts to monetize Array’s remaining wireless spectrum assets.
With the withdrawal, TDS expects to recommence repurchases under its programs; ~$523.9M remained available as of June 30, 2026.
